player_prompt.intro:
Tella d Anẓaṛ {player_id} tetteddu ajed n Tizirin sɣur {color}.
Rnu aseɣwen-ik s tsɛṛṛit n chess-style [fileRank fileRank], sɛɛṛḍ '[b2c3]' (akala n uɛelay a–h, n umḍal 0–7).
Imsiwen isɛan:
  • Rnu aseɣwen si zdat ɣer wadda ma yella wadda.
  • Sken asebɣu s yijen ɣer yixef.
  • Asebɣu yettwaṭṭef ma yefraḥ ɣer tama n tayeḍ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Urɛad ara aseɣwen sɣur amḍan. Sken [a1b2], sɛɛṛḍ [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Red has no pieces left. Black wins!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Black has no pieces left. Red wins!
outcome.no_moves: Amyurar {player_id} ur d-yeqqim ara kra n uḥewwes.
outcome.draw: The turn limit has been reached.
